name: quest-perf-skills
description: Performance skill bundles for Unity URP apps on Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3/3S: platform and Meta SDK, Unity 2021.3 through Unity 6.x, OpenGL ES 3.x, and Snapdragon XR2 (ARM CPU + Adreno GPU) hardware. Every skill targets throughput (lower average frame time) or consistency (stable frame delivery).

plugins.name: quest-perf
plugins.description: Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3/3S platform performance for Unity: triage, budgets and tiers, frame pacing and thermals, resolution and foveation, Application SpaceWarp, compositor layers, mixed-reality costs, SDK choices, and profiling tools.

plugins.name: unity-perf
plugins.description: Unity 2021.3 LTS through Unity 6.x URP performance on Quest: version matrix and upgrade risks, URP settings, Render Graph on tile GPUs, batching, shaders and PSO hitches, lighting, CPU and GC, memory and assets, profiling workflow.

plugins.name: gles3-perf
plugins.description: OpenGL ES 3.0/3.1/3.2 on Meta Quest: an honest GLES-vs-Vulkan decision, tile-friendly rendering, multiview, driver and state overhead, shader compilation, Adreno extensions, and GLES capture.

plugins.name: arm-mobile-hw-perf
plugins.description: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 1 and Gen 2 hardware in Quest 2 and Quest 3/3S: ARM CPU cores and thread placement, Adreno 650/740 architecture, shader cost model, memory bandwidth, thermals, and Snapdragon Profiler.
